authority: Agentique operational interpretation explicitly authorized for v9; outside the published KerML 1.0 baseline

interpretation.operational: When a Multiplicity owningNamespace is an owned cross Feature, inherit the featuringType of that cross Feature owning end Feature. Every bound Expression inherits the same context.

historical_profiles: Published and operational v1-v8 remain unchanged

reference_behavior.ordinary: MultiplicityAdapter.doTransform invokes FeatureAdapter.addImplicitFeaturingTypesIfNecessary, using owningNamespace when it is a Feature
reference_behavior.owned_cross_bound: ExpressionAdapter.addImplicitFeaturingTypesIfNecessary selects the owning end featuringType for a MultiplicityRange bound owned by a cross Feature
reference_behavior.operational_scope: Authorized v9 applies that cross correction consistently to both the Multiplicity and its bounds
